title: Star2, Eh La & TaeTae stir up emotions with new single "Kokaine"
htmlContent: Star2, EH LA, and TaeTae release their latest single, "Kokaine," as a lethal force combining pain, violence, and power. This partnership crackles with energy from that first beat, a pulsating rhythm shuddering under raw, emotional storytelling. Blending English and Thai lyrics, the track is a cross-cultural maelstrom, transcending language barriers as it drags you into its depths. "Kokaine" is a song about the intoxicating chaos of love that's a dangerous high you can't part with, even when it's ripping you apart. Star2, along with EH LA and TaeTae, embodies the push and pull of desire and destruction, painting visceral images from a relationship in which heartbreak and addiction are intertwined. https://open.spotify.com/track/4skpeP6FHerx1pvr44M5WL Star2 was born in the Mae La refugee camp to parents who fled fighting between Karen rebels and government soldiers. He aims to raise the voices of his community, and that mission beats like a heart through every lyric and beat. Featuring fellow refugee artists EH LA and TaeTae, "Kokaine" is a testament to the courage of continuing to create and assert identity. Groovy and volatile, melodic and fierce, "Kokaine" is the sound of survival undergirded by rhythm. With this release, Star2, EH LA, and TaeTae show that in pain, there's power and in chaos, there's beauty. "Kokaine" is an unfiltered, undeniable, unforgettable heartbeat.
